m20.text: The Baron of Vernot, a noble of Luneau, captures and tortures Vivien in Core Set 2020, having stolen her Arkbow, but she refuses to reveal its secrets.
He moves her to a gilded prison where she remains in magical stasis, then summons her to witness a monstrosaur's vivisection and demands that she teach him to use the Arkbow.
Vivien feigns cooperation, but when he forces her to perform the ritual she lets the Arkbow reject his guard and unleashes a dying monstrosaur's essence, which kills him.
